judgement.reason: Tuwunel stores all homeserver data in an embedded RocksDB database on local disk (database_path), and it has no PostgreSQL or MySQL option, so Deployz's stateless containers without persistent volumes cannot hold its core data.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported storage: the app declares durable local state (database_path = /database (nix/pkgs/complement/config.toml)) with no VOLUME or Compose mount. Deployz provides object storage, not an attached data directory.
reviews.reason: The selected Dockerfile configures Tuwunel to keep its RocksDB database in /database on local disk, and no shown setting moves that data to PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis or S3, so the homeserver needs a persistent disk.
